sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page and reference search (langdoc) for Ngaalam / Olam / Ngalam / Baale
sources.note: Only three refs attach to ngaa1241 (Yigezu 2018, Bender 1977, Bryan 1945); Glottolog's most extensive description = wordlist or less. No grammar, sketch or phonology exists for Ngaalam in hh.bib.

sources.citation: Wikipedia 'Baale language' and 'Surmic languages' articles (checked for cited sources on Olam/Ngaalam)
sources.note: List Olam (Ngaalam) as a Baale variety / sister; cite only Dimmendaal 2002 survey, Unseth, Moeller 2009, Yigezu 2005 -- none about Ngaalam phonology.

sources.citation: Dimmendaal, Gerrit J. 2003. Baale language. Encyclopaedia Aethiopica vol. 1 (text already held by the project under kaci1244)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Entry on Baale (kaci1244), read for any mention of Olam/Ngaalam: none; no prosody statement. Different languoid.

sources.citation: Bender, M. Lionel. 1977. The Surma language group: a preliminary report. Studies in African Linguistics, Supplement 7, 11-21.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Comparative Surma phonology notes (pp. 16-17) discuss tone/stress only for Murle, Mursi, Majang, Bodi, Muguji; Ngalam/Olam appears only in the membership survey (pp. 12-13: 'people without cattle', Olam-Zilmamu-Bale cluster, minimal ~30-item data from Hoekstra). Nothing on Ngalam/Olam stress or accent.

sources.citation: Dimmendaal, Gerrit J. 2020. Baale. In R. Vossen & G. J. Dimmendaal (eds.), The Oxford Handbook of African Languages, 631-644. Oxford: OUP.

sources.note: Most recent sketch of Baale with a phonology section (tone described as register tones); may mention Ngaalam/Olam following Yigezu 2018. Different languoid (kaci1244).

sources.citation: Moges Yigezu & Gerrit J. Dimmendaal. 1998. Notes on Baale. In G. J. Dimmendaal & M. Last (eds.), Surmic Languages and Cultures (Nilo-Saharan 13), 273-317. Koeln: Koeppe.

sources.harvard_location: Widener Library (offsite storage), call number PL8694.S97 S87 1998
sources.note: 45-pp sketch of Baale, Ngaalam's closest relative (Baale-Olam node); its phonology section (tone/accent) is the nearest proxy and may comment on Olam. Note: describes kaci1244, not ngaa1241.
